title: WhatsApp Inbox
subtitle: Lead conversations, ownership and follow-up in one staff workspace.

empty.title: No WhatsApp conversations yet
empty.description: Conversations appear here as soon as WhatsApp delivers a message to this app. Chats that happened before incoming delivery was switched on cannot be imported, so nothing is shown for them.
empty.select: Select a conversation to open the student profile and messages.

status.waitingHelp: No incoming WhatsApp message has reached this app. Open Connectors → WhatsApp Business → Incoming messages and select the receiving project.
status.receivingHelp: Incoming messages are arriving and are stored automatically.

conversation.noMessages: No provider messages recorded for this conversation.
conversation.takeoverHelp: Keeps the assigned advisor visibly responsible. AI never sends automatically.
conversation.windowOpen: A human reply is allowed inside the 24-hour service window.
conversation.windowClosed: Use an approved template for business-initiated messages outside WhatsApp’s service window.
conversation.noTemplateReleased: No approved template has been released yet. Ask an administrator to make one available.
conversation.composerLocked: Replies are locked until the contact writes again — send an approved template below.

ai.title: AI assist
ai.safe: Drafts only. Never auto-sends or promises prices, acceptance, timelines, or legal/visa outcomes.
ai.empty: Generate a draft or summary after selecting a conversation.

dashboard.operationalHelp: Live queue health for team follow-up.

templates.title: Approved outbound templates
templates.required: Business-initiated WhatsApp messages require a Meta-approved template.
templates.noneDescription: The connected WhatsApp Business account currently returns no templates. Submit a template here for provider review before using it.
templates.createHelp: WhatsApp reviews every template. Submission does not make it immediately available.
templates.bodyPlaceholder: Write the exact message for provider review…

start.title: Start a WhatsApp conversation
start.description: Open or create one WhatsApp conversation. When the number already belongs to a DARB record, the conversation is connected to that record instead of creating a duplicate.

errors.load: WhatsApp workspace could not be loaded.
errors.send: The WhatsApp message could not be sent.
errors.templates: WhatsApp templates could not be updated.
errors.ai: AI assist could not create a safe draft.
errors.start: The WhatsApp conversation could not be created.

crm.pending: No DARB identity is linked yet.

snooze.scheduleHelp: Choose an approved utility template and a future time. The follow-up stays server-side and will be cancelled if the student replies.
snooze.customHelp: Choose exactly when this conversation should return to the team queue.

campaigns.title: WhatsApp campaigns
campaigns.subtitle: Send marketing campaigns only to contacts who have granted marketing consent.
campaigns.createHelp: Choose an approved marketing template and build an audience from contacts who opted in.
campaigns.name: Campaign name
campaigns.noTemplates: No approved active marketing template without variables is available.
campaigns.scheduleHelp: Leave blank to start now. Scheduling is available from 5 minutes in the future.
campaigns.createdNow: Campaign created and queued for sending.
campaigns.policyConsent: Only contacts with marketing_consent_status = granted are eligible.
campaigns.policyApproved: The template must be MARKETING, approved, and active.
campaigns.policyRecheck: Consent and template availability are re-checked immediately before every send, so later opt-outs block delivery.
campaigns.policyNoVariables: Campaigns currently support fixed marketing templates without {{1}}-style variables.
campaigns.historyHelp: Progress and delivery state for every campaign.
campaigns.kickFailed: The campaign was created, but the first dispatch kick failed; the scheduler will retry automatically.
